title: Capybara Bakery
kdp_subtitle: Cute Capybaras and Friends Baking Cakes, Cupcakes and Cookies to Color, with Mazes and Puzzles for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: The capybara bakery is open! Cakes, cupcakes and
cookies are ready for your brightest colors.
description:
The capybara bakery is open for business!

Capybara Bakery is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Capybaras, bunnies, bears, mice, kittens and pandas
  • Cakes, cupcakes, donuts, cookies and strawberries
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A yummy gift for kids who love capybaras, baking and sweet treats.
